origin: Original FIVE C implementation of integer restoring square root, authored as a common concrete math binding

target.result_rounding: nearest ties to even via exact integer remainder threshold

method: 23 finite normalization blocks for subnormal input; 24 restoring blocks on a 48-bit radicand; nearest significand selected from integer root/remainder; explicit exceptional-value bit policy
formal_status: Empirical and frontend probes only. Requested Csem safety, termination and correspondence proofs remain separate. No formal IEEE sqrt accuracy theorem asserted.
resource_scope: Shared parent C binding implementation/probes, not retroactively split or duplicated per case
